profiles.selector_label_it: HED mobility with external policy funds: project control and for regional partnership

scoring.note_it: 40/40/20 grid: quality of design is project-specific, strategy and impact are assessed for each regional partnership; each region must achieve 60/100 and half of the maximum for each criterion. No IDEA scores. Do not use the HED Consortium Accreditation Grid (pp.44–46) as the KA171 Universal Grid.

criteria.label_en: Quality of the project design and cooperation arrangements

checks.official_focus_it: Clarity of responsibilities, roles and tasks between partners.
checks.idea_question_it: Who selects, prepares, hosts, finances and recognizes mobilities?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with a first matrix of applicant and partner tasks and resources; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document an initial matrix of the tasks and resources of the applicant and partner, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Distribute tasks and communication channels before estimating flows.
checks.applicability_it: Entire project: response and control only once, even for consortia.

checks.official_focus_it: Relevance to the respect and promotion of EU values ​​​​​​and the fight against any discrimination.
checks.idea_question_it: Which selection and cooperation choices protect dignity, freedom, democracy, equality, rule of law and human rights?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with proposed choices for fair access and protection of EU values; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document proposed choices for fair access and protection of EU values, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Integrate EU values ​​into mobility processes.
checks.applicability_it: Entire project, including partner institutions in non-associated countries.

checks.official_focus_it: Completeness and quality of selection, support and recognition of the mobility period, especially in the non-associated country.
checks.idea_question_it: How will students and staff be selected and supported and achievements recognized at both institutions?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with an inclusive selection draft, logistical and linguistic support and recognition of learning; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and form, verify and document an inclusive selection draft, logistical and linguistic support and recognition of learning, updating hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Provide learning agreements, supports and recognition before mobility.
checks.applicability_it: Entire project; specify the mechanisms for each type of mobility and country.

checks.official_focus_it: Relevance of mobility to the internationalization strategy of the institutions involved.
checks.idea_question_it: What internationalization objective does this regional partnership address for applicants and partners?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with objectives of the internationalization strategies of both parties and their connection to flows; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document the objectives of the internationalization strategies of both parties and their connection to the flows, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Define a mobility logic distinct by region.
checks.applicability_it: Every regional partnership, even from the point of view of non-associated partners.

checks.official_focus_it: Reason for the choice of staff and/or student mobility.
checks.idea_question_it: Why do you need staff, students or both for this region, and in what volume?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with motivation of the profiles, proposed volumes and capacity of the institutions; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document the motivation of the profiles, the volumes proposed and the capacity of the institutions, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Adapt flows to real strategy and capabilities.

checks.official_focus_it: Motivation for cooperation with institutions/organizations in specific countries of the region.
checks.idea_question_it: Why are these countries and institutions relevant to the proposed regional cooperation?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with reasons for choosing countries and institutions, with previous experience if available; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document reasons for the choice of countries and institutions, with previous experience if available, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Justify geography with cooperation needs and objectives.
checks.applicability_it: Each regional partnership; do not omit the specific choice of countries.

checks.official_focus_it: Potential impact on participants, applicants and partners at local, regional and national levels.
checks.idea_question_it: What plausible changes will this regional partnership produce during and after the project?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with expected changes and first monitoring proposal for people and institutions; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document expected changes and first monitoring proposal for people and institutions, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Separating mobility products and effects in institutions.
checks.applicability_it: Every regional partnership, in all countries involved.

checks.official_focus_it: Quality of dissemination at faculty and institutional level and beyond, where relevant, in all countries involved.
checks.idea_question_it: Who will use the findings in the faculty, institution and beyond, and through what channels?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Note IDEA with audiences, shareable results and dissemination channels for applicants and partners; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and form, verify and document audiences, shareable results and dissemination channels of applicants and partners, updating hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Assign recipients and reuse channels for each region.
checks.applicability_it: Each regional partnership; external staircase proportionate to the relevance.

source_sections_read.section: Award criteria and adjacent route conditions

limits: Profile referring to the Program Guide 2026 v1 (12/11/2025) and, where cited, to the Expert Guide 2026 v1 (22/12/2025) received in the mandate. It does not certify online verification of corrigenda, rounds, national provisions, form or subsequent updates.
Exhaustive coverage concerns the selected grid, not all eligibility, general conditions, financial model or a complete verification of the call.
Questions, IDEA tests and implications are internal operational translations; final evidence can be collected in subsequent stages. The examples are not project data.

The Expert Guide p. 17 groups together choice of staff/students and previous experience; the sub-point on the choice of countries is kept separately according to the Program Guide p. 62. Regional conditions and additional restrictions NA p. 61 require specific verification.
Profile, policy, and control IDs are internal and not official identifiers. The expert guide specifications do not introduce independent weights.

profiles.selector_label_it: Erasmus VET/SCH/ADU accreditation: Individual plan or consortium coordination

scoring.note_it: Accreditation, not required annual KA121: 10/40/20/30, minimum 70/100 and half in each criterion. The assessment is separate for VET, SCH and ADU. No IDEA scores.

checks.official_focus_it: Relevance of profile, experience, activity and learner population to the sector, accreditation objectives and type of application.
checks.idea_question_it: What ordinary activity and population make the organization relevant to the chosen sector and variant?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with operational profile, experience and learner groups of the organization; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and form, verify and document the organisation's operational profile, experience and groups of learners, updating hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Choose sector and individual/consortium variant consistent with the real activity.

checks.official_focus_it: Relevance to the respect and promotion of EU values ​​​​​​and the fight against discrimination.
checks.idea_question_it: How does the Erasmus Plan make dignity, freedom, democracy, equality, rule of law and human rights concrete?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with choices to protect EU values ​​​​​​​​​​and non-discriminatory access; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document choices for the protection of EU values ​​and non-discriminatory access, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Integrate EU values ​​into management and activities.

checks.official_focus_it: Relevance of future members to the consortium's purpose, sector and accreditation objectives.
checks.idea_question_it: Which member profiles are needed to achieve the consortium's stated purpose?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with proposed member profiles and contributions to the common goal; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document proposed profiles of the members and contributions to the common purpose, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Define the perimeter of the consortium through a shared purpose.
checks.applicability_it: Consortium coordinator variant only; do not apply to individual application.

checks.official_focus_it: Clear added value of the consortium for its members with respect to the objectives of the accreditations.
checks.idea_question_it: What common benefit is obtained by organizing mobilities as a consortium?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with comparison between individual options and proposed benefits of the consortium; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document the comparison between the individual option and the proposed benefits of the consortium, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Justify the consortium versus an individual alternative.

checks.official_focus_it: Consistency of the Erasmus Plan with the objectives of accreditations.
checks.idea_question_it: Which accreditation objective translates the Plan into organizational change?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with connection between accreditation objectives and preliminary objectives of the Plan; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document the connection between the accreditation objectives and the preliminary objectives of the Plan, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Deriving the Plan from the accreditation purposes.

checks.official_focus_it: The objectives of the Plan clearly and concretely address the needs of the organisation, staff and learners.
checks.idea_question_it: What distinct organizational, staff, and learner needs explain each objective?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with initial diagnosis of needs and proposal of objectives; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document the initial diagnosis of needs and proposal of objectives, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Write goals that are traceable to diagnosis.

checks.official_focus_it: For the coordinators, the objectives cover the entire consortium and are consistent with its purpose.
checks.idea_question_it: What common needs and member differences does the Consortium Plan address?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with proposed needs and objectives for the entire consortium; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and form, verify and document the needs and objectives proposed for the entire consortium, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Design benefits and goals for the membership.

checks.official_focus_it: Objectives and timescales are realistic and ambitious enough for positive impact.
checks.idea_question_it: What changes and timing are credible with respect to the resources of the organization or consortium?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Notes IDEA with objectives, time horizon and capacity constraints; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and form, verify and document objectives, time horizon and capacity constraints, updating hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Balancing ambition, timing and ability to implement.

checks.official_focus_it: The measures to follow and evaluate the progress of the objectives are concrete and appropriate.
checks.idea_question_it: How will progress towards each objective of the Plan be tracked?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with first proposal for indicators, baseline and verification frequency; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, first verify and document the proposal of indicators, baseline and frequency of verification, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Associate a measure of progress with each goal.

checks.official_focus_it: If attached, the connection between the Plan and strategic documents is clearly explained.
checks.idea_question_it: Which Plan choice derives from any strategic documents attached?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with references to strategic documents and correspondence with objectives; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document references to the strategic documents and correspondence with the objectives, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Use relevant strategic attachments and explain their role.
checks.applicability_it: Only if strategic documents are attached; Don't make them mandatory.

checks.official_focus_it: The number of participants is proportionate to the size and experience of the organization.
checks.idea_question_it: What scale of mobility can the organization manage with quality?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Note IDEA with size and experience of the organization and preliminary volume of mobility; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and form, verify and document the size and experience of the organization and the preliminary volume of mobility, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Calibrate the volumes to the available capacity.

checks.official_focus_it: For coordinators, the expected size of the consortium must be considered.
checks.idea_question_it: Does the proposed volume take into account the size and capacity of the members?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with expected consortium size and volume distribution; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document the expected size of the consortium and distribution of volumes, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Estimate volumes for the entire consortium.

checks.official_focus_it: The number of participants is realistic and adequate for the objectives of the Plan.
checks.idea_question_it: How many participants and what activities are needed for each expected change?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with connection between mobility volumes and Plan objectives; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document the connection between mobility volumes and the objectives of the Plan, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Justify the number of participants with the expected result.

checks.official_focus_it: Participant profiles are relevant to the sector, the Plan and the objectives of the accreditation.
checks.idea_question_it: Which profiles can transfer learning to the sector and organization?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with profiles of participants and their role in the objectives; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document participant profiles and their role in the objectives, updating hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Select recipients who contribute to the goals.

checks.official_focus_it: Where relevant, learner mobilities involve people with fewer opportunities.
checks.idea_question_it: What barriers do learners face and how can the Plan engage them?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Note IDEA with groups with fewer opportunities, barriers and proposed supports; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and form, verify and document groups with fewer opportunities, barriers and proposed supports, updating hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Provide inclusive recruitment and supports.
checks.applicability_it: Where relevant and if mobility of learners is envisaged.

checks.official_focus_it: Concrete contribution to the basic principles of Erasmus quality standards.
checks.idea_question_it: How will the quality principles be applied in the planned mobilities?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with proposed actions on inclusion, sustainability, digital dimension and Erasmus network; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document proposed actions on inclusion, sustainability, the digital dimension and the Erasmus network, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Translate quality principles into concrete tasks.

checks.official_focus_it: Clear and complete division of tasks compliant with Erasmus standards.
checks.idea_question_it: Who takes on every critical task without delegating quality decisions?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with first responsibility matrix according to quality standards; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document the first responsibility matrix according to quality standards, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Assign all management and learning tasks.

checks.official_focus_it: Adequate resources to manage activities according to Erasmus standards.
checks.idea_question_it: What people, time and resources allow you to manage the expected volumes?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with preliminary estimate of management resources; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document preliminary estimates of management resources, updating hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Scale management with respect to activities.

checks.official_focus_it: Appropriate involvement of the organization's management.
checks.idea_question_it: Who in management will support the Plan and integration decisions?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with proposed management roles and necessary decisions; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and form, verify and document proposed management roles and necessary decisions, updating assumptions with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Provide management support for the implementation of the Plan.

checks.official_focus_it: Continuity of activities in the event of staff or management changes.
checks.idea_question_it: How will the Plan continue if key people change?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with role backup, documentation and proposed handover; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and form, verify and document backups of the proposed roles, documentation and handover, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Reduce dependence on individual people.

checks.official_focus_it: Concrete and logical steps to integrate the results of mobility into ordinary work.
checks.idea_question_it: Which ordinary procedures or activities will change thanks to mobilities?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with first adoption measures and related managers; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document initial adoption measures and related managers, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Linking mobility and change in ordinary work.

checks.official_focus_it: For coordinators, integration concerns the entire consortium.
checks.idea_question_it: How will each member use the results of the mobilities in their work?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with adoption proposals for consortium members; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document adoption proposals for the members of the consortium, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Distribute reuse and integration across the entire consortium.

limits: Profile referring to the Program Guide 2026 v1 (12/11/2025) and, where cited, to the Expert Guide 2026 v1 (22/12/2025) received in the mandate. It does not certify online verification of corrigenda, rounds, national provisions, form or subsequent updates.

profiles.selector_label_it: Short-term mobility VET/SCH/ADU with conditional sector subpoints

scoring.note_it: Weights and thresholds concern the evaluated candidacy; no points are awarded to the IDEA. The IDs are internal and the subpoints do not have separate weights.

checks.official_focus_it: Relevance of profile, experience, activity and learner population to the application sector.
checks.idea_question_it: Which ordinary activities and learners demonstrate the real link with VET, SCH or ADU?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Note IDEA with operational profile, experience and recipients of the chosen sector; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and form, verify and document the operational profile, experience and recipients of the chosen sector, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Choose the sector consistent with ordinary work.

checks.official_focus_it: Relevance of the proposal to the objectives of the action.
checks.idea_question_it: What objective of short-term mobility does the project address?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with action objectives and link to proposal; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document the objectives of the action and connection to the proposal, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Delimit mobility proportionate to the action.

checks.official_focus_it: Relevance to the respect and promotion of EU values ​​​​​​and the fight against discrimination.
checks.idea_question_it: How do selection, supports and activities materialize EU values ​​and non-discriminatory access?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with proposed actions to protect EU values ​​and fair access; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document proposed actions to protect EU values ​​and fair access, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Insert EU values ​​​​​​​​​​and non-discrimination into processes.

checks.official_focus_it: Support new or less experienced organisations.
checks.idea_question_it: How does the proposal open up opportunities for those who have not regularly benefited from the action?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Note IDEA with previous experience and access proposal for newcomers; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document previous experience and access proposal for newcomers, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Use short mobility as a proportionate entry into the program.

checks.official_focus_it: Support for participation in ErasmusPro.
checks.idea_question_it: Is an ErasmusPro mobility relevant and what needs and supports make it realistic?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with ErasmusPro hypotheses, learner needs and support capacity; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document ErasmusPro hypotheses, learner needs and support capacity, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Evaluate long form when relevant.
checks.applicability_it: KA122-VET only; verify the relevance of ErasmusPro.

checks.official_focus_it: Support for pupils' long-term learning mobility.
checks.idea_question_it: Is long-term pupil mobility relevant and sustainable for this school?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with hypotheses of long mobility, student needs and supports; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document hypotheses of long mobility, student needs and supports, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Evaluate long form when relevant.

checks.official_focus_it: Support for participants with fewer opportunities.
checks.idea_question_it: What barriers can prevent mobility and what supports will reduce them?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: Note IDEA with profiles with fewer opportunities, barriers and supports proposed; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and form, verify and document profiles with fewer opportunities, barriers and proposed supports, updating hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Design inclusive selection and supports.

checks.official_focus_it: In ADU the expert guide clarifies the importance of an inclusive and balanced mix with significant involvement of people with fewer opportunities.
checks.idea_question_it: How does the mix of adults and activities generate significant inclusion in quantity or quality?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with preliminary mix of adult recipients and intensity of inclusive supports; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document the preliminary mix of adult recipients and intensity of inclusive supports, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Planning inclusion also through the quality of supports.
checks.applicability_it: KA122-ADU only; clarification of the expert guide on the inclusion subpoint, without new weight.

checks.official_focus_it: The objectives clearly and concretely address needs of the organisation, staff and learners.
checks.idea_question_it: What organizational, staff and learner need explains each objective?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with initial diagnosis and preliminary objectives; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document the initial diagnosis and preliminary objectives, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Connect needs and objectives for change.

checks.official_focus_it: Activities are appropriate to achieve goals.
checks.idea_question_it: Why does the proposed mobility format produce the necessary learning?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with connection between proposed activities, learning and objectives; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document the connection between proposed activities, learning and objectives, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Choose activities to contribute to the objectives.

checks.official_focus_it: Appropriate and cost-effective operational and logistical aspects.
checks.idea_question_it: Which locations, times and logistical solutions allow quality at proportionate costs?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with first logistical estimate and comparison with alternatives; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document the first logistical estimate and comparison with alternatives, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Evaluate a relevant and less costly operational alternative when possible.

checks.official_focus_it: Environmentally sustainable and responsible practices.
checks.idea_question_it: Which choices about travel, resources and activities reduce environmental impact?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with preliminary travel choices and sustainable management; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document preliminary travel and sustainable management choices, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Provide green practices in content and logistics.

checks.official_focus_it: Digital tools and learning methods complement physical mobility and improve cooperation with hosts.
checks.idea_question_it: Which digital activities prepare, accompany and continue learning and cooperation?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with proposed use of digital tools: eTwinning for SCH/iVET, EPALE for cVET/ADU where relevant; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and form, verify and document proposed use of digital tools: eTwinning for SCH/iVET, EPALE for cVET/ADU where relevant, updating hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Integrate digital tools with an educational and cooperative function.
checks.applicability_it: KA122-VET: eTwinning iVET and EPALE cVET; KA122-SCH: eTwinning; KA122-ADU: EPALE.

checks.official_focus_it: Clearly defined tasks and responsibilities for activities according to Erasmus standards.
checks.idea_question_it: Who will carry out preparation, mobility, learning and follow-up?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with first division of tasks compliant with quality standards; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document the initial division of tasks compliant with quality standards, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Assign mobility and follow-up tasks.

checks.official_focus_it: Concrete and logical steps to integrate the results into the normal activity of the organization.
checks.idea_question_it: What ordinary practice will change after the mobility and who will adopt the outcome?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with proposals for integrating the results into ordinary work; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document proposals for integrating the results into ordinary work, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Design the transfer from individual experience to the organization.

checks.official_focus_it: Appropriate way of evaluating project results.
checks.idea_question_it: How will it be verified whether objectives and learning have been achieved?
checks.evidence_at_idea_it: IDEA note with first proposal for evaluation of outcomes and objectives; distinguish available evidence, proposal and hypothesis, and indicate the subsequent collection needed.
checks.later_verification_it: In the design and in the form, verify and document the first proposal for evaluating the outcomes and objectives, updating the hypotheses with confirmed data and responsibilities.
checks.design_implication_it: Define success measures before mobility.
